walkthroughs.body_html:
Component 02: Externally Set Task — a core area of A-Level Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 02: Externally Set Task brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 02: Externally Set Task.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the typical word count range for the A-Level personal investigation written element?
options: 100-500 words

mcqs.q: What term describes research drawn from books, articles and online sources?
options: Primary research
Secondary research
Practical research
Empirical research

mcqs.q: What is the significance of Duchamp's 'Fountain'?
options: It challenged the definition of art - the artist's choice, not their skill, becomes the artwork.
Because white is the most expensive colour.
It demonstrated his sculpting ability.
It is a study of plumbing.

mcqs.q: Why is preserving white in watercolour important?
options: Because white is the most expensive colour.
You can simply paint white over other colours later.
White comes from the paper showing through - there is no true white pigment in traditional watercolour.
It is a study of plumbing.

mcqs.q: What is appropriation in postmodern art?
options: Painting in an old-fashioned style.
Stealing artwork to sell.
Deliberately reusing existing images or styles, often to comment on originality.
Because white is the most expensive colour.
